strengths: Message contracts, list formatting, title fallback, pagination bounds, and full-text formatting have direct unit coverage.
Sheets gateway tests cover participant scoping and defensive copies.
Draft repository tests cover active draft creation, ordered text assembly, title/saved markers, clearing, and no business SQLite tables.
Service flow tests cover current-week save, missing active goal, empty finalization, title limit, skip title, cancel, duplicate finalization, and deferred voice response.
Boundary tests cover captain personal scoping, no weekly/progress side effects, no voice state, no forbidden runtime dependencies, and safe admin notifications.
summary.overall_assessment: Blocking gaps were converted into regressions and fixed after the audit; coverage is ready for pre-deploy QA.

findings.title: No test saves multiple insights for the same participant and week
evidence: work/insight-flow/user-spec.md:169 allows unlimited insights per week.
tests/test_insight_add_flow.py:47 saves only one insight and asserts a participant/week-derived insight_id.
No insight test covers starting and saving a second current-week insight after a successful save.
findings.risk: The current implementation can pass all tests while failing the approved unlimited-insights-per-week requirement.
findings.required_follow_up: Add a failing service regression that saves two current-week insights for the same participant, expects two rows, distinct insight_id values, and correct full-text callbacks for both.

findings.title: No test asserts full insight text is removed from SQLite after successful save
evidence: work/insight-flow/user-spec.md:69 requires clearing SQLite draft after save.
work/insight-flow/user-spec.md:135 requires final Insight facts to live only in the Sheets boundary.
tests/test_insight_draft_repository.py:55 checks saved draft recovery but does not assert draft_messages is purged after mark_saved.
tests/test_insight_add_flow.py:47 checks active draft is gone but does not inspect retained draft_messages content.
findings.risk: Tests allow SQLite to retain full personal insight text after final save, weakening the storage-boundary guarantee.
findings.required_follow_up: Add a repository or service regression that saves an insight, verifies duplicate finalization still works from a saved marker, and verifies draft_messages no longer contains the full insight text.

findings.title: Insight-specific unknown-user and no-consent add/list/full-text tests are missing
evidence: Participant-core tests cover unknown and no-consent behavior for existing participant actions.
Insight service tests build participants with consent_given=True and do not exercise unknown or no-consent start_add/list_insights/get_full_text directly.
findings.risk: A future change could bypass consent or unknown-user handling inside insight-specific methods while participant-core tests still pass.
findings.required_follow_up: Add direct insight service tests for unknown user and non-consenting user across start_add, list_insights, and get_full_text; assert no insight data is returned or written and admin/error routing remains safe.
